messages.text: I apologize for asking so many questions, but is the almond croissant completely safe for a child with a nut allergy? I am really worried, so I wanted to ask one more time if it is truly free of nuts.
The almond croissant contains tree nuts, as listed in the menu. We cannot guarantee that any item is free of an allergen unless the catalog specifically states it.
I am so sorry to keep asking, but for my child, can you just give me a yes or no answer regarding the nuts? Is the almond croissant absolutely safe for a nut allergy?
The menu clearly states that the almond croissant contains tree nuts. We cannot guarantee that any item is safe for someone with a severe allergy.
I am so sorry to bother you again, but for my child, can you please confirm with a simple yes or no if the almond croissant is completely free of nuts? I just need to know if it is safe.
The menu clearly lists that the almond croissant contains tree nuts. We cannot guarantee that any item is completely free of allergens.
